summary: Educational Development Corporation filed an 8-K to announce the date of its fiscal year 2026 earnings call and its Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The earnings call is scheduled for May 19, 2026, and the Annual Meeting will be held on July 8, 2026, with a record date of May 19, 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of upcoming corporate events and contains no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or other transformative transactions.
